Agent.description: A game agent screenshots can be drawn with.
Agent.title: Agent

BatchFinish.description: A knife finish name a batch can use, and how many active knife types have it.
BatchFinish.title: BatchFinish

BatchIn.description:
New combos of one glove finish with one knife finish name across knife types, and
rating and description changes to existing combos of the same batch.
BatchIn.title: BatchIn

ComboCounts.description:
Published combos per finish, by type slug then finish slug; finishes without any are left
out.
ComboCounts.title: ComboCounts

Conditions.description:
What one item of a combo needs: a float range, when wear matters, and pattern seeds,
when the combo needs specific patterns (empty means any).
Conditions.title: Conditions

JobItem.description:
An item as the viewer identifies it, the float and seed to draw it with, and the
combo's full conditions.
JobItem.title: JobItem

KnifeOrderIn.description: Every active knife type's slug, once, in the new order.
KnifeOrderIn.title: KnifeOrderIn

PublishRequest.description: Combos to publish: `ids`, or every draft with `all_drafts`. Exactly one of them.
PublishRequest.title: PublishRequest

Screenshot.description: A screenshot's public versions, narrowest first, and the original's size.
Screenshot.title: Screenshot

ScreenshotState.description:
`none`: no screenshot yet. `waiting`: an older screenshot is shown, a new one is due.
`done`. `failed`: three failed attempts for the current render inputs.
ScreenshotState.title: ScreenshotState

in knife order, with the combo it already has with these gloves, if any.

delete.description:
Delete a draft or unpublished combo, at the version it was read at, and its
screenshot. A published combo must be unpublished first.

get.description: One combo, in any status.

put.description:
Change a combo's rating, description and conditions. `version` is the version the
change was made from; another version refuses it. The pairing and status do not change.

get.description: Active knife types in the order batches follow.

put.description: Replace the knife order. The list must name every active knife type exactly once.

post.description: Log in with a username and password. Sets the session cookie.
End the current session, if there is one, and clear the cookie.

get.description: The logged-in admin and the session's CSRF token.
The default screenshot agent, used by every combo without its own.

put.description:
Change the default screenshot agent. Combos without their own agent get a new
screenshot; `requeued` counts those whose screenshot was done.

post.description:
Ask for a new screenshot of each combo: due at once, with its failed attempts cleared.
The current screenshot stays shown until the new one is stored.

get.description: Every screenshot worker, revoked ones included, oldest first.

post.description: Create a screenshot worker. Its token is in this response only.
